item: Row 344: a descriptor handed to a file object is closed exactly once
summary: os.fdopen inside try/except BaseException: os.close(fd) (open_regular, create_new, folder_backup._hash_fd) and inside a try whose finally closes it (manifest_file.read_manifest_json) closed the descriptor a second time when the failure came after the file object existed: an interrupt before the return, or an error building the buffer (io.open then closes the raw file itself). The second close could take a number another open owned meanwhile, a SQLite connection's above all, dropping the process's locks on that file (R789). One helper, regular_file.adopt_fd, builds the file object over a FileIO that does not own the number and hands ownership over in its last statement, so a failure before it closes the number here once and nothing after it does. Tests inject the failure right after the FileIO is built, put another file on the freed number and check it survives; an AST guard fails on any os.fdopen left in a try that also closes the descriptor.
